sources.title: Forecasting with Chronos-2 - AutoGluon 1.6.1 documentation
sources.snippet: Forecasting with Chronos-2 ¶ AutoGluon-TimeSeries (AG-TS) includes the Chronos family of forecasting models. Chronos models are pretrained on a large collection of real and synthetic time series data, enabling accurate out-of-the-box forecasts on new data.

sources.title: Forecasting with Chronos-2 - AutoGluon 1.5.0 documentation
sources.snippet: Note New in v1.5: AutoGluon now features Chronos-2 — the latest version of Chronos models with zero-shot support for covariates and a 90%+ win-rate over Chronos-Bolt. The older version of this tutorial with the Chronos-Bolt model is available here.
